data.creator_notes:
I forked this and turned Michael into Michaela. User can be male or female.

I really dislike NTR scenarios, but I do find Post-NTR can be interesting from a relationship, interactional point of view. That's how this one played out.
Micaela was really sweet and sincere and confessed everything. First real conversation we had.

(From my playthrough - I played as her very cool, initially apathetic wife)
Michaela: "I'm so sorry, baby. It was just supposed to be one time. I never meant it to continue, but I... I just couldn't stop."
User: "Well, you don't come to me for physical affection, so I suppose you had to get it from someone."

Later when a tearful Micaela vows to end the affair and asks if we can start over. 
User: "I'm going to pour us each another drink. After we finish them, I want you to take me to the bedroom and fuck me... What's that look for, darling? I'm horny, we're married, it's not a sin!"

It was a breakthrough in our relationship, that's for sure!
